summary: IndyDevDan released fusion-harness (disler/fusion-harness) expanding on SSSF and multi-model collaboration. Core patterns: (1) Model Fusion over Monoculture: prompt routed concurrently across 2-5 models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, local) to evaluate opinions and token economics; (2) Role specialization: Architect (planning/ambiguity) vs Main Builder vs Sidekicks; (3) Explicit workflow commands: /fh-opinion (multi-model design plans), /fh-debate (cross-model critique/gap-filling), /fh-fusion (synthesizing consensus code), /fh-auto-validate (writer-lease atomic access and test gates); (4) Tokenomics optimization: metric of effective agent hours per token cost to combine frontier leads with cheap/fast sidekicks.
